name: codex-pager-plugin
description: Bridge a private T-Lora Pager room to a dedicated Codex task.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to a dedicated Codex task over private MeshCore.

interface.defaultPrompt: Check the Codex T-Lora Pager bridge status and explain any problem without changing live services.
